dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: The more effort you put in now, the better your chances of victory will be down the road.

dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: As you can see, I'm preparing for our future battles.

dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: It's unlikely I'll be joining them on the battlefield anytime soon, no thanks to my old injuries. But the least I can do is pass on my battlefield experience to others.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You must be tired from conducting the training, Sergeant Major.

dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: That was nothing compared to the work you fellas have to do. But you, Illuga, always remember that resting when necessary is just as much a soldier's duty.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I know that. You too, don't work yourself too hard either.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: Sorry I can't walk you out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Imparting your experience is also an important part of the job.

dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: That's all I can do at this point. The real battlefield is thousands of times tougher than any training ground, so we've got to get every bit of preparation done right now.

dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: ...And when that day finally comes, I hope they can all take the field, certain they will win.
